rows.label: Concept
rows.text: The elements are an input transducer, a transmitter that modulates, a medium, and a receiver with an output transducer. The message and the modulated carrier are different signals. The medium is where attenuation and noise appear.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Amplitude modulation and frequency modulation are two ways to load the carrier.  ·  Fibre uses light as the carrier.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: The elements can be named as transducer, modulator and transmitter, medium, and receiver plus output transducer. This is the same chain as source, transmitter, channel and receiver, with the transducers made explicit.  ·  A microphone is an input transducer: sound pressure becomes a voltage. A loudspeaker is an output transducer: the recovered voltage becomes sound again.

rows.label: Quick concepts
rows.text: Transducer  ·  Modulated wave  ·  Medium  ·  Demodulator

rows.label: Key points
rows.text: A transducer starts the electrical chain.  ·  The transmitter modulates and amplifies.  ·  The medium may be cable or space.  ·  The destination is the user.

rows.label: Universal facts
rows.text: answer pattern for "Elements of a communication system": define → method → result. Structure earns the marks on 6–10 mark questions.

rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: The message signal is often low frequency. Multiplying it with a carrier, or varying the carrier's amplitude or frequency, produces the modulated wave that the antenna launches.  ·  The medium decides the loss. A copper pair, a fibre and a radio path have different attenuation and different noise. The link budget is the comparison of transmitted power with the power the receiver needs.  ·  At the receiver a tuner selects the carrier, a demodulator strips it, and an amplifier raises the message to a useful level. Selecting the wrong carrier selects a different message.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: The loudspeaker is not the channel.  ·  The message signal and the modulated wave are different.  ·  Amplifying after noise has been added amplifies the noise too.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: A transducer is not the same device as the modulator.  ·  Name the transducer at each end.  ·  The medium is physical. The message is not.
